Load one trace, build ObsPy Stream, run PhaseNet classify: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np, glob, os from obspy import Stream, Trace, UTCDateTime import seisbench.models as sbm  fn=sorted(glob.glob('/root/data/*.npz'))[0] z=np.load(fn, allow_pickle=True) data=z['data'] dt=float(z['dt']) channels=str(z['channels']).split(',') start=str(z.get('start_time','1970-01-01T00:00:00.0Z')) try:     stime=UTCDateTime(start) except Exception:     stime=UTCDateTime(0)  sr=1.0/dt st=Stream() for i,ch in enumerate(channels):     tr=Trace(data=data[:,i].astype('float32'))     tr.stats.network=str(z.get('network','XX'))     tr.stats.station=str(z.get('station','STA'))     tr.stats.location=str(z.get('location_code',''))     tr.stats.channel=ch     tr.stats.starttime=stime     tr.stats.sampling_rate=sr     st+=tr  model=sbm.PhaseNet.from_pretrained('original') # Try classify picks=model.classify(st) print('num picks',len(picks)) print('first 5',picks[:5]) if picks:     p=picks[0]     print('pick attrs', [a for a in dir(p) if not a.startswith('_')][:30])     print('phase',p.phase,'time',p.time,'peak_time',getattr(p,'peak_time',None),'prob',getattr(p,'probability',None)) PY

Inspect PhaseNet classify output object structure: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np, glob from obspy import Stream, Trace, UTCDateTime import seisbench.models as sbm  fn=sorted(glob.glob('/root/data/*.npz'))[0] z=np.load(fn, allow_pickle=True) data=z['data']; dt=float(z['dt']); sr=1/dt channels=str(z['channels']).split(',') start=str(z.get('start_time','1970-01-01T00:00:00.0Z')) stime=UTCDateTime(start)  st=Stream() for i,ch in enumerate(channels):     tr=Trace(data=data[:,i].astype('float32'))     tr.stats.network=str(z.get('network','XX'))     tr.stats.station=str(z.get('station','STA'))     tr.stats.location=str(z.get('location_code',''))     tr.stats.channel=ch     tr.stats.starttime=stime     tr.stats.sampling_rate=sr     st+=tr  model=sbm.PhaseNet.from_pretrained('original') out=model.classify(st) print('type',type(out)) print('dir', [a for a in dir(out) if not a.startswith('_')]) # try common accessors for attr in ['picks','detections','phases','items','to_dataframe','__iter__']:     if hasattr(out, attr):         print('has',attr)  # attempt iterate try:     it=list(out)     print('iter len',len(it),'first',it[:2]) except Exception as e:     print('cannot iterate',e)  # maybe dict-like try:     print('keys',out.keys()) except Exception as e:     print('no keys',e)  # print repr print('repr',out) PY

Compare PhaseNet and EQTransformer pick coverage on random files: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np, glob, random from obspy import Stream, Trace, UTCDateTime import seisbench.models as sbm  def stream_from_npz(fn):     z=np.load(fn, allow_pickle=True)     data=z['data']; dt=float(z['dt']); sr=1/dt     chs=str(z['channels']).split(',')     stime=UTCDateTime(str(z.get('start_time','1970-01-01T00:00:00Z')))     st=Stream()     for i,ch in enumerate(chs):         tr=Trace(data=data[:,i].astype('float32'))         tr.stats.network=str(z.get('network','XX'))         tr.stats.station=str(z.get('station','STA'))         tr.stats.location=str(z.get('location_code',''))         tr.stats.channel=ch         tr.stats.starttime=stime         tr.stats.sampling_rate=sr         st+=tr     return st  files=sorted(glob.glob('/root/data/*.npz')) random.seed(1) sample=random.sample(files, 20)  ph=sbm.PhaseNet.from_pretrained('original') eq=sbm.EQTransformer.from_pretrained('original')  c_ph=c_eq=0 for fn in sample:     st=stream_from_npz(fn)     out1=ph.classify(st, P_threshold=0.03, S_threshold=0.03)     out2=eq.classify(st, P_threshold=0.03, S_threshold=0.03)     has_ph = any(p.phase=='P' for p in out1.picks)     has_eq = any(p.phase=='P' for p in out2.picks)     if has_ph: c_ph+=1     if has_eq: c_eq+=1 print('sample size',len(sample)) print('PhaseNet files with P:',c_ph) print('EQTransformer files with P:',c_eq) PY

Compute PhaseNet P/S max probabilities for some files with no picks: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np, glob, random from obspy import Stream, Trace, UTCDateTime import seisbench.models as sbm  model=sbm.PhaseNet.from_pretrained('original')  def mkst(fn):     z=np.load(fn, allow_pickle=True)     data=z['data']; dt=float(z['dt']); sr=1/dt     chs=str(z['channels']).split(',')     stime=UTCDateTime(str(z.get('start_time','1970-01-01T00:00:00Z')))     st=Stream()     for i,ch in enumerate(chs):         tr=Trace(data=data[:,i].astype('float32'))         tr.stats.network=str(z.get('network','XX'))         tr.stats.station=str(z.get('station','STA'))         tr.stats.location=str(z.get('location_code',''))         tr.stats.channel=ch         tr.stats.starttime=stime         tr.stats.sampling_rate=sr         st+=tr     return st  files=sorted(glob.glob('/root/data/*.npz')) random.seed(2) for fn in random.sample(files, 8):     st=mkst(fn)     out=model.classify(st, P_threshold=0.05, S_threshold=0.05)     if len(out.picks)>0:         continue     ann=model.annotate(st)     pmax=[tr.data.max() for tr in ann if tr.stats.channel.endswith('_P') or tr.stats.channel.endswith('Net_P') or tr.stats.channel.endswith('PhaseNet_P')]     smax=[tr.data.max() for tr in ann if tr.stats.channel.endswith('PhaseNet_S')]     nmax=[tr.data.max() for tr in ann if tr.stats.channel.endswith('PhaseNet_N')]     print(fn.split('/')[-1],'no picks','Pmax',float(pmax[0]),'Smax',float(smax[0]),'Nmax',float(nmax[0])) PY

Compare annotate argmax indices vs classify picks for one file: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np, glob from obspy import Stream, Trace, UTCDateTime import seisbench.models as sbm  fn=[f for f in sorted(glob.glob('/root/data/*.npz')) if 'NC.MDH..HN.0358192' in f][0] z=np.load(fn, allow_pickle=True) data=z['data']; dt=float(z['dt']); sr=1/dt chs=str(z['channels']).split(',') stime=UTCDateTime(str(z.get('start_time','1970-01-01T00:00:00Z')))  st=Stream() for i,ch in enumerate(chs):     tr=Trace(data=data[:,i].astype('float32'))     tr.stats.network=str(z.get('network','XX'))     tr.stats.station=str(z.get('station','STA'))     tr.stats.location=str(z.get('location_code',''))     tr.stats.channel=ch     tr.stats.starttime=stime     tr.stats.sampling_rate=sr     st+=tr  model=sbm.PhaseNet.from_pretrained('original') ann=model.annotate(st) P=ann.select(channel='*PhaseNet_P')[0] S=ann.select(channel='*PhaseNet_S')[0] p_idx=int(P.data.argmax()) s_idx=int(S.data.argmax()) print('annotate argmax P idx',p_idx,'val',float(P.data[p_idx])) print('annotate argmax S idx',s_idx,'val',float(S.data[s_idx]))  out=model.classify(st, P_threshold=0.05, S_threshold=0.05) for p in out.picks:     if p.phase=='P':         print('classify P idx',int(round((p.peak_time-stime)*sr)),'val',float(p.peak_value))     if p.phase=='S':         print('classify S idx',int(round((p.peak_time-stime)*sr)),'val',float(p.peak_value)) PY

Check annotation trace lengths and alignment relative to input samples: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np, glob from obspy import Stream, Trace, UTCDateTime import seisbench.models as sbm fn=[f for f in sorted(glob.glob('/root/data/*.npz')) if 'NC.MDH..HN.0358192' in f][0] z=np.load(fn, allow_pickle=True) data=z['data']; dt=float(z['dt']); sr=1/dt chs=str(z['channels']).split(',') stime=UTCDateTime(str(z.get('start_time','1970-01-01T00:00:00Z')))  st=Stream() for i,ch in enumerate(chs):     tr=Trace(data=data[:,i].astype('float32'))     tr.stats.network=str(z.get('network','XX'))     tr.stats.station=str(z.get('station','STA'))     tr.stats.location=str(z.get('location_code',''))     tr.stats.channel=ch     tr.stats.starttime=stime     tr.stats.sampling_rate=sr     st+=tr  model=sbm.PhaseNet.from_pretrained('original') ann=model.annotate(st) print('input npts', [tr.stats.npts for tr in st]) print('ann npts', [(tr.stats.channel,tr.stats.npts,tr.stats.starttime,tr.stats.endtime) for tr in ann]) PY

Compute PhaseNet P/S max probability distribution across all traces: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np, glob from obspy import Stream, Trace, UTCDateTime import seisbench.models as sbm  model=sbm.PhaseNet.from_pretrained('original')  def mkst(fn):     z=np.load(fn, allow_pickle=True)     data=z['data']; dt=float(z['dt']); sr=1/dt     chs=str(z['channels']).split(',')     stime=UTCDateTime(str(z.get('start_time','1970-01-01T00:00:00Z')))     st=Stream()     for i,ch in enumerate(chs):         tr=Trace(data=data[:,i].astype('float32'))         tr.stats.network=str(z.get('network','XX'))         tr.stats.station=str(z.get('station','STA'))         tr.stats.location=str(z.get('location_code',''))         tr.stats.channel=ch         tr.stats.starttime=stime         tr.stats.sampling_rate=sr         st+=tr     return st  pmax=[]; smax=[] files=sorted(glob.glob('/root/data/*.npz')) for fn in files:     st=mkst(fn)     ann=model.annotate(st)     P=ann.select(channel='*PhaseNet_P')[0].data.max()     S=ann.select(channel='*PhaseNet_S')[0].data.max()     pmax.append(float(P)); smax.append(float(S))  import numpy as np for name,arr in [('P',np.array(pmax)),('S',np.array(smax))]:     qs=np.quantile(arr,[0,0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9,1])     print(name,'quantiles', {q:float(v) for q,v in zip([0,0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9,1],qs)})     print(name,'count>0.1', int((arr>0.1).sum()),'count>0.3',int((arr>0.3).sum()),'count>0.5',int((arr>0.5).sum())) PY

Check waveform amplitude statistics for one no-pick and one pick file: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np, glob  def stats(fn):     z=np.load(fn, allow_pickle=True)     x=z['data']     return dict(min=float(x.min()), max=float(x.max()), std=float(x.std()), mean=float(x.mean()))  no_fn=[f for f in glob.glob('/root/data/*.npz') if 'BG.NEG..DP.0343655' in f][0] yes_fn=[f for f in glob.glob('/root/data/*.npz') if 'NC.MDH..HN.0358192' in f][0] print('no',no_fn.split('/')[-1],stats(no_fn)) print('yes',yes_fn.split('/')[-1],stats(yes_fn)) PY

s_tr.stats.starttime) * s_sr))     s_start = max(0, min(len(s_tr.data), p_on_s + int(round(0.2 * s_sr))))     if s_start < len(s_tr.data) - 1:         s_i_rel = int(np.argmax(s_tr.data[s_start:]))         s_i = s_start + s_i_rel     else:         s_i = int(np.argmax(s_tr.data))     s_time = s_tr.stats.starttime + s_i * s_tr.stats.delta      p_idx = int(round((p_time -
